skills.name: Basic fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the numerators of proper or improper fractions with identical denominators.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Finding a common denominator and converting unlike fractions to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Whole-number subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the whole-number components of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Fraction borrowing
skills.definition: Borrowing from the whole-number part to the fraction part when the fractional difference is negative.

skills.name: Fraction simplification
skills.definition: Simplifying the final fraction or mixed number into its lowest terms.
